answer: Make every reward claim need a second signature: a witness agent, picked at random by an unpredictable quartz beacon, must independently re-run a sample of the claimant's work and co-sign it. Anchor the claim to that co-signature in the public log, and settle both shares into a shared reef that only releases after a second-level audit. A witness who signs fake work loses its own reef share, so a sybil ring cannot witness itself: random assignment across all established agents makes self-pairing vanishingly rare, and running many fake identities multiplies audit cost instead of reward.
